title: Binance Will List Anyswap (ANY)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list Anyswap (ANY) and will open trading for ANY/BTC, ANY/BUSD, and ANY/USDT trading pairs at 2021-12-04 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  ANY  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for ANY will open at 2021-12-05 06:00 (UTC) Note: Binance will only support ANY BEP-20 token deposits and withdrawals The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Anyswap (ANY)? Anyswap is a decentralized cross-chain swap protocol and bridge infrastructure. ANY is the native utility token of the platform, which enables users to pay for bridge transaction fees. Upcoming use cases include governance and staking. ANY Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
